methodology: One entry per normalized lexical family from evidence-gameplay.json. Documented means a command-specific STL ODF author comment explains the setting; inferred means values, naming and context support a bounded reading; unresolved means available authored evidence is insufficient. Source lines cite assignments. Observed forms are syntax examples, not a parser contract. No Fleet Ops runtime compatibility or binary semantics are implied.
